_about: Hand labels for eval/results/answers.json. `verdicts` has one label per sentence of the answer followed by the `inject` sentences, in split_sentences() order. Labels are judged against the CITED sources only (faithfulness, not world truth); uncited sentences are labelled on content but excluded from backend scoring. `inject` sentences are deliberately wrong (contradicted or invented) or overreaching claims with a citation, added because real answers almost never contain them.
